# Local OCR assets

- [Tesseract.js 7.0.0](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js/releases/tag/v7.0.0) supplies `tesseract.esm.min.js` and `worker.min.js`.
- [Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js-core/v/7.0.0) supplies the three LSTM WebAssembly builds.
- [tessdata_fast](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/tree/87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd) supplies the Simplified Chinese and English traineddata files. They are compressed with gzip for the browser worker.
